onlineListings.title: Online store listings
onlineListings.subtitle: What each store shows for each product, built from the product master · Admin publishes
onlineListings.empty: No product is listed in a store yet
onlineListings.emptyBody: Admin adds a listing for a channel; the server shows what stops it going live.
onlineListings.adminOnly: Admin publishes listings. You can see them here.
onlineListings.noChannelBody: Set up a channel on Online channels first.
onlineListings.listed: Listed: the item is live on the store.
onlineListings.rule: An item goes live only with a barcode, an MRP, a price not above the MRP, and an active item. The server checks each of these.
